on the right arm and an interchangeable weapons mount on the left. The YVH also has low-power repulsorlifts built into its legs, giving it an extra boost on jumps.

Tendrando Arms continues to develop specialized YVH Droids after the Yuuzhan Vong Invasion. Several types of personal Guardian Droids are designed for specific owners. The Guardian Droids might or might not look like typical YVH units, depending on the cultural environment in which they are expected to operate. Their appearances are often softened to conceal their true function.
